# Web Awesome Core 3.14.0

The `dist-cdn` files here are a local subset of the official `@awesome.me/webawesome` 3.14.0 package: button, input, checkbox, textarea, and badge modules, their relative JavaScript dependencies, and the theme CSS dependencies. Source: `https://registry.npmjs.org/@awesome.me/webawesome/-/webawesome-3.14.0.tgz`.

The copied files retain their notices. See `LICENSE.md` for the MIT terms. No default remote icon library is configured or used by this UI.
